entries.title: Slimes are villagers, never enemies
entries.body: Gloob is a slime; the village's slimes are villagers. No slime enemies. The old slime enemies (chaser, swarmer, exploder, sludge, slimeGlob, slimeSplat) are retired.

entries.title: No office or work jokes anywhere in Sick Of It
entries.body: No Mondays, inboxes, meetings, coffee, bosses-as-managers: not in titles, lines, upgrades or result quips. The humor is the hero's attitude and Hell itself.

entries.title: Hell is repetition; rewind is the hero's power
entries.body: Hell runs everything on a loop; the hero grabs the loop and pulls it backward (Deja Vu, hold R). Rewind orbs are loop shards dropped by the damned. Death sends you back to repeat floors ("YOU OBVIOUSLY DIED").

entries.title: The climb: 1,000 floors counting down, Overlord at Floor 1
entries.body: The portal drops the hero at Floor 1,000; the Overlord sits at Floor 1 under the meadow, feeding the stolen diamonds into a gate. 10 Circles of 100 floors, each with one biome, one enemy family and one Warden at its top floor (901, 801, ... 101). The floor number is always on screen.

entries.title: The cast of Sick Of It
entries.body: The Hero (name working): thirties, unimpressed, one-liners, never speeches. The Overlord: giant obsidian titan, red eyes, never in a hurry. Gloob (working): the village's gossip slime who swallowed diamonds and runs the shop. The Announcer: Hell's booming 90s arcade voice. The Wardens: one boss per Circle.
entries.tags: cast hero overlord gloob announcer wardens

entries.title: Every enemy has a reason to be on its floor
entries.body: One Circle, one family; a new enemy arrives alone; look comes from the art pipeline, never a tint of a different creature. Imps are the Overlord's raiders carrying the diamonds; Cinders are sparks from the burning village; the Magma King is Circle X's Warden.
entries.tags: enemies rules imp cinder magma king

entries.title: Diamonds are the village's portal fuel; Gloob works them into gear
entries.body: Enemies drop the stolen diamonds back; the shop is Gloob (permanent upgrades). Between-level picks are Grudges (lost when a run ends): Spite Rounds, Short Fuse, Not Today, Deja Vu.

entries.title: Circle X is the Ember Wastes (floors 1000-901)
entries.body: Lava rivers where the portal spits out everything that falls through. First stage: Level6, "Floors 1000-976: The Landing".
